ucm_acm_faith_refresh_display_lists_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = { has_variable = ucm_selected_faith_var }
    clear_global_variable_list = ucm_acm_fe_display_core_tenets
    clear_global_variable_list = ucm_acm_fe_display_main_group
    clear_global_variable_list = ucm_acm_fe_display_marriage
    clear_global_variable_list = ucm_acm_fe_display_crimes
    clear_global_variable_list = ucm_acm_fe_display_clergy
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = { main_rite = { save_scope_as = ucm_fe_rite } }
    if = {
      limit = { scope:ucm_fe_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_peace_of_god } }
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_core_tenets target = flag:tenet_peace_of_god }
    }
    if = {
      limit = { scope:ucm_fe_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_dulia } }

    }

      limit = { scope:ucm_fe_rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_funeral_grave_stake } }
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_clergy target = flag:doctrine_funeral_grave_stake }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = { scope:ucm_fe_rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_funeral_green_pact } }
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_clergy target = flag:doctrine_funeral_green_pact }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = { scope:ucm_fe_rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_funeral_cannibalism } }
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_clergy target = flag:doctrine_funeral_cannibalism }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = { scope:ucm_fe_rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_funeral_crystalization } }
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_clergy target = flag:doctrine_funeral_crystalization }
    }
    else = {
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_clergy target = flag:doctrine_funeral_stoic }
    }
    if = {
      limit = { scope:ucm_fe_rite = { rite_has_doctrine = doctrine_no_anointment } }
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_clergy target = flag:doctrine_no_anointment }

      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_clergy target = flag:doctrine_imperial_anointment }

    else = {

    if = {

    else = {

    }
  }
}

ucm_acm_faith_apply_choice_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      scope:ucm_pick_doctrine = flag:tenet_peace_of_god
      var:ucm_selected_faith_var = { main_rite = { NOT = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_peace_of_god } } }
    }
    ucm_acm_faith_remove_slot_tenet_effect = yes
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = { main_rite = { add_rite_tenet = tenet_peace_of_god } }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = {
      scope:ucm_pick_doctrine = flag:tenet_dulia
